description: Schema for one NER-detected mention in the VCL primary text.
principles: Separate mentions, name variants, and individual people.
Do not assign a person automatically unless an explicitly approved safe alias applies.
Keep every decision tied to the exact occurrence by default.

fields.source_id: Original volume and OCR page-key identifier.
fields.span_start: Character offset within the page text.
fields.span_end: Exclusive character offset within the page text.
fields.observed_span: Exact text extracted from the source.
fields.label: NER category, such as PERSON_NAME, PERSON_REF, TITLE_OR_ROLE, GROUP_OR_POLITY, PLACE_OR_TERRITORY, or ORG.
fields.title: Parsed title or role when present; never used as an identity by itself.
fields.name_string: Name portion after parsing, preserving historical spelling.
fields.name_variant_group_id: Optional human-maintained grouping of equivalent observed forms.
fields.resolved_person_id: Person assigned to this occurrence, if reviewed or matched by a safe alias.
fields.resolution_status: unreviewed, suggested, reviewed, unresolved, or auto_resolved_safe_alias.
fields.resolution_rule_id: Rule or safe-alias record responsible for the assignment.
fields.non_merge_check: Authority-file constraint check before any person assignment.

automatic_resolution_rule: Only an explicitly approved global safe alias may populate resolved_person_id without occurrence-level review.
